Earlier scenes:

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This time expression is redundant because 古代 already names a time period; add 在 instead. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：看到，Here the verb means that Shennong perceived the people, so it needs the resultative complement 到. [rule: resultative_complement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，别人 means “other people” in contrast with a stated person or group; this sentence refers generally to the people who were becoming sick. [teacher rule: bieren]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule; 在古代 is correct.
Here 看 needs the resultative complement 到 to mean that Shennong caught sight of the people.
别人 is wrong here, but the recently mentioned people should be referred to as 他们 rather than repeated as 人们.
